messages:
Alice M: Quick async question — we have inconsistent cancellation semantics across SDKs when aborting streaming responses. Anyone seen this?
Ben K: Yep. Node SDK accepts AbortController.signal; if you call abort mid-stream it closes the socket but sometimes the server finishes sending a partial chunk.
Carla R: in Go our client uses context.Context. Doing `ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Second)` works for timeouts but canceling during ReadStream sometimes leaves goroutines stuck waiting on io.Read.
Dan: C# takes CancellationToken; we observed the token triggers but the underlying HttpClient still buffers remaining response until it's dropped — so streaming callbacks stop but network doesn't cancel immediately.
Ben K: Example Node usage:
```js
const controller = new AbortController();
const r = client.generate({ input: '...', signal: controller.signal });
setTimeout(()=> controller.abort(), 1500);
for await (const chunk of r) { console.log(chunk); }
```
Carla R: Go example:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
// cancel() after some time
```
Alice M: Main issue: retries and client-side backoff replays when a cancel happens. Some SDKs treat abort as a non-retriable error, some as retriable. That causes duplicate work or hanging.
Dan: Agree. We should map abort -> non-retriable.
CI-Bot: reminder: open issue #442 "SDK: unify cancellation semantics" assigned to @carla
Carla R: Proposal: 1) all SDKs accept a single named param (signal / ctx / token) 2) abort maps to a well-documented AbortError type 3) streaming generators yield final error and then close 4) abort should not trigger retries at transport layer by default
Ben K: Also add test harness: spawn server that emits long stream, client abort, assert no extra requests and goroutine leak checks.
Alice M: ok can someone draft a short RFC and a compatibility plan (migration notes for breaking changes)? I'll review.
Carla R: I'll draft RFC today and include code snippets for Node/Go/Python/C# and a test matrix.
Ben K: Ping me for the Node bits, I'll add a few tests.
Dan: I'll write C# doc and how CancellationToken links to HttpClient.CancelPendingRequests.
Alice M: thx! Keeping this thread for async followups. :thumbsup:
